bullets.text: Activities per advisor reached 11.2 this week, above the trailing 13-week average of 10.6 and the third straight weekly increase (9.8, 10.8, 11.2).
Among the two branches, BR-0202 leads on activities per advisor at 12.0 (up 9.1% weekly), while BR-0201 is flat at 10.7.
Weekly outbound calls rose 3.2% to 32.0 and clients contacted rose 8.8% to 37.0.
Appointments booked fell 27.3% to 8.0, and appointment conversion fell 45.5% to 36.4%. BR-0201 conversion dropped to 33.3% and BR-0202 to 40.0%.
13-week coverage rose to 85.7%; BR-0202 is at 96.3% and BR-0201 at 79.1%. EON show rate was 91.7%.

answer.headline: EON activities per advisor rose 3.7% this week to 11.2, up from 10.8.

watchlist.reason: Trails its peer on activities per advisor (10.7 vs 12.0), show rate (85.7% vs 100.0%), appointment conversion (33.3% vs 40.0%) and 13-week coverage (79.1% vs 96.3%).
